title: Existence & Essence
author: Anindita Bose
text:
In some frames of time I felt that
you did exist, yet I kept that thought
away and wandered through life...

In a mystic moment when I sensed
your essence, I held my beating heart
in my mind and walked through the
dreams.

In one moment you entered into my
world with pages to explore, I stopped
and wondered - will you stay long?

I have met none like you, the one
who builds castles for others and not
in the air but rooted deep in soil...

someone who nurtures magic and sails
through the turmoil of life without hoping
to find any pillars...

You hold each one close to your heart
and sing the songs of manifestation.

Now I found you... or did you find me?

And I watch you with my curious eyes to
know if we are part of the same destiny...
